title: 2008 yil: Airbnb asoschilari nonushta yormasi sotgan

scenes.keywords: young entrepreneurs walking city street night

scenes.text: 2008 yilda Airbnb asoschilari qarzga botib, pulsiz qolgan edi.
scenes.keywords: founders working late laptop small apartment

scenes.text: Ular saylov mavzusidagi nonushta yormasi qutilarini o'zlari yasab sotishdi.
scenes.keywords: people packing boxes by hand workshop

scenes.text: Shu yo'l bilan taxminan 30 ming dollar yig'ishdi.
scenes.keywords: small business owner handing box to customer

scenes.text: Keyin ular Y Combinator dasturiga qabul qilindi.
Sen qaysi birini tanlaysan: taslim bo'lishnimi yoki g'ayrioddiy yo'lnimi?
scenes.keywords: woman running up city steps sunrise

description: 2008 yilda pulsiz qolgan Airbnb asoschilari saylov mavzusidagi Obama O's va Cap'n McCain's nonushta yormasi qutilarini yasab sotishgan va taxminan 30 ming dollar yig'ishgan. Keyin ular Y Combinator dasturiga qabul qilingan.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-07 (PASS; ~$30,000 is the figure Chesky himself cites, box count varies by source so the script gives no count). CNBC, 2023-04-18, Chesky: https://www.cnbc.com/2023/04/18/airbnb-ceo-says-he-wooed-first-investors-with-boxes-of-cereal.html (>1,000 boxes at $40, $30,000); Benzinga: https://benzinga.com/z/18700895 ; Business Insider, 'How a box of cereal and acting like a cockroach helped Airbnb become a billion-dollar business'; Airbnb joined Y Combinator in the Winter 2009 batch (Paul Graham accounts); Leigh Gallagher, 'The Airbnb Story' (2017).
